BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(MONITORING) RULES,
2006
[Gazette of Balochistan
Extraordinary
4th August, 2006]
No. 2-800/2006 (BL,GB)AO, dated
4-8-2006.--In exercise of the powers conferred by section 191 (1) of the
Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 2001 (Ordinance No. XVIII of 2001), the
Government of Balochistan is pleased to make the following rules namely:--
1. Short Title and Commencement.---(1)
These Rules may be called the Balochistan Local Government (Monitoring) Rules,
2006.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In these Rules,
unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall have the
same meanings as hereby respectively assigned to them:--
(a) Chairman means Chairman of Monitoring
Committee elected under these rules who shall also be a member of the
Monitoring Committee.
(b) Forms means forms appended to these
Rules;
(c) Member means Member of the Monitoring
Committee;
(d) Monitoring means the systematic
collection and analysis of information in order to determine whether various
functions assigned to the Local Government Offices are being performed
according to performance plan and desired targets or otherwise;
(e) Monitoring Committee means the
Committee elected and notified under these Rules by the respective Local
Government.
(2) Words and expressions used but not
defined in these rules shall have the same meanings are assigned to them in the
Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 2001.
3. Constitution and Composition of
Monitoring Committees.--(1) The following Monitoring Committees for
different tiers of Local Government shall be constituted:--
(a) Union
Monitoring Committees.
(i) Municipal Services.
(ii) Health.
(iii) Education & Literacy.
(iv) Works and Services.
(v) Taxation.
(b) Tehsil/Town
Monitoring Committees.
(i) Municipal Regulations.
(ii) Infrastructure and Services.
(iii) Planning & Coordination.
(iv) Taxation
(c) Zila Monitoring
Committees.
(i) Agricultural.
(ii) Community Development.
(iii) Education & Literacy.
(iv) Health.
(v) Information Technology.
(vi) Revenue.
(vii) Works & Services.
(2) There shall be constituted a
Monitoring Committee consisting of not less than three and not more than five
members including its Chairman. The exact number of members (from 3 to 5) for
each Monitoring Committee, mentioned before, shall be determined by the
concerned Local Council.
(a) One third of the members of
Monitoring Committees shall consist of members, from reserved seats for women,
peasants, workers and minorities;
(b) The term of the Monitoring Committees
shall be equal to the tenure of the respective Local Government;
(c) Chairman & members of Monitoring
Committee shall be elected in the manner as prescribed in these rules.
4. Election of the Monitoring Committees.---(1)
The concerned Naib Nazim will act as presiding officer for the election of the
Monitoring Committees in Tehsil/Town and Zila Councils. Whereas, the concerned
Union Nazim will conduct election of Monitoring Committees in Union Councils
and will notify the results in the manner as may be prescribed by the Local
Council concerned.
(2) Election of Monitoring Committees
shall be conducted within three months from the date of first session of the
concerned Local Council.
(3) Each member of the Council will cast
a vote in favour of anyone of the contesting candidates of the Monitoring
Committees through a secret ballot.
(4) Elections of different Monitoring
Committees will be held separately (one Committee at a time).
(5) The Monitoring Committees shall
obtain vote of confidence from the Council Members, after the completion of the
first year.
(6) Any Council Member can contest for
more than one Monitoring Committee constituted under the Ordinance and Rules
framed thereunder.
(7) Member who obtains highest vote for
the Monitoring Committee would be the Chairman of Monitoring Committee.
